title: Choc Chip Cookies I’ve tried a lot of “HEALTHY” low ingredient cookie...
description: Choc Chip Cookies I’ve tried a lot of “HEALTHY” low ingredient cookies, most taste like shit unless they have a truck load of peanut butter which puts the calories through the roof. These are easy to make & the macros are sound.  🍪Makes 12 cookies 👨‍🍳 Dry Ingredients   ✅ Plain Flour, 100g, 3.5oz ✅ PB2 Powder, 40g, 1.4oz ✅ Vanilla Protein Powder, 80g, 2.8oz 🚨(Use a whey/casein blend otherwise you’ll need to add more flour to achieve a dough consistency) ✅ Granulated Sweetener, 80g, 2.8oz ✅ Corn Starch, 10g, 0.35oz ✅ Baking Powder, 1/2 tsp ✅ Baking Soda (bi carb soda), 1/4 tsp ✅ Instant Coffee, 1/2 tsp ✅ Salt, pinch 👇Mix these together👇 ✅ Light Butter, 40g, 1.4oz ✅ Brown Sugar Replacement, 60g, 2.1oz 🧈 Wet Ingredients ✅ Unsweetened Applesauce, 135g, 4.8oz ✅ Egg Whites, 200ml, 6.8 fl oz ✅ Vanilla Extract, 1 tbsp, 15ml, 0.5 fl oz 🍫 Add Ins ✅ Sugar Free Dark Chocolate Chips, 80g, 2.8oz 👉 Method 1. Preheat oven to 180°C, 355°F. 2. In a bowl, whisk together the light butter, granulated sweetener, brown sugar replacement until smooth and creamy. 3. Add applesauce, vanilla extract and egg whites, then whisk again until fully combined. 4. In a separate bowl, combine all dry ingredients. 5. Slowly add wet ingredients into dry ingredients until the dough forms.  6. You may need to add more flour depending on the kind of protein powder you’ve used!  7. Fold through chocolate chips. 8. Use an ice cream scoop to form 12 cookie dough balls and place onto a lined baking tray. Slightly flatten the tops. 9. Place into the fridge for 30–60 minutes to firm up. This helps create thicker cookies with a better texture. (Don’t skip this part) 10. Optional but elite, sprinkle a little flaky salt on top before or after baking. 11. Bake for 9–11 minutes until the edges are lightly golden but the centres still look slightly underdone. 12. LET COOL FULLY before eating because they continue setting outside the oven. 📊 Calories and macros, per cookie Calories: 123 kcal | P: 10g | C: 14g | F: 4g
